content: xunit.v3 4.0.1 (4.0.0 on 2026-08-14) dropped MTP v1; MTP v2 default (xunit.v3 depends on xunit.v3.mtp-v2). On .NET 10 SDK enable MTP for dotnet test via global.json {"test":{"runner":"Microsoft.Testing.Platform"}}. coverlet.collector is VSTest-only; use coverlet.MTP 10.1.0 (MIT, --coverlet --coverlet-output-format cobertura); its docs say threshold validation not yet supported -> enforce with ReportGenerator/script. Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage ships Microsoft proprietary license.
